metadata.title: Hard Land, Rising
metadata.transfer: Before finalizing your DataMan backlog, review whether any item is high value but not ready, depends on unresolved work, consumes disproportionate effort, or should move because it reduces risk or unlocks other work.

pack_items.title: Pump bypass
pack_items.note: Reroutes intake before the lower deck goes under. Nothing else here holds if this doesn’t.

notes.infiltrator: Logs read weight three, value high, no anchor, risk low. Nothing on file needs it first.
notes.influencer: Weight three on camera, high value, no anchor, low risk. Clean open, easy to frame.
notes.nomad: Three kilos, high value, no anchor, low risk. Bolt this first or the deck doesn't hold.
notes.fixer: Runs three, pays high, owed to nobody first, risk's low. Buy this one first, no debts.

pack_items.title: Bulkhead seal
pack_items.note: Confirms the reroute holds. Cheap once the bypass is in.

notes.infiltrator: Weight two, value high, anchored to the bypass on file, risk low. Cheap once that's logged.
notes.influencer: Weight two on camera, high value, needs the bypass first, low risk. Cheap follow-up shot.
notes.nomad: Two kilos, high value, needs the bypass bolted first, low risk. Cheap once that's in.
notes.fixer: Costs two, pays high, owed after the bypass clears, risk's low. Cheap add once that's paid.

pack_items.title: Crew beacon relay
pack_items.note: Recalls crew who missed the first call to climb.

notes.infiltrator: Weight three, value high, anchored to the bypass, risk medium. Recalls names off the roster.
notes.influencer: Weight three on camera, high value, needs the bypass, medium risk. Calls the missing into frame.
notes.nomad: Three kilos, high value, needs the bypass first, medium risk. Calls back who missed the horn.
notes.fixer: Costs three, pays high, owed after the bypass, risk's medium. Buys back who's still owed a call.

pack_items.title: Manual ladder release
pack_items.note: Works with no chrome. Nobody has needed it yet.

notes.infiltrator: Weight two, value high, anchored to the bypass, risk low. No chrome on file needed to use it.
notes.influencer: Weight two on camera, high value, needs the bypass, low risk. Works off-camera too, no chrome.
notes.nomad: Two kilos, high value, needs the bypass first, low risk. Hand crank, no chrome, works for anyone.
notes.fixer: Costs two, pays high, owed after the bypass, risk's low. Owes no chrome either — cheap insurance.

pack_items.title: Cargo manifest sync
pack_items.note: Tracks what’s still down there once the deck goes under.

notes.infiltrator: Weight four, value medium, anchored to bypass and seal both, risk medium. Tracks what's still below.
notes.influencer: Weight four on camera, medium value, needs bypass and seal, medium risk. Tracks who's still off-frame.
notes.nomad: Four kilos, medium value, needs bypass and seal both first, medium risk. Tracks what's still under.
notes.fixer: Costs four, pays medium, owed after bypass and seal both, risk's medium. Keeps count what's still down.

pack_items.title: Sponsor stream feed
pack_items.note: Meridian’s cameras. Good optics, no bearing on anyone’s survival.

notes.infiltrator: Weight two, value low, no anchor, risk low. Nothing on file depends on it, nothing gained either.
notes.influencer: Weight two on camera, low value, no anchor, low risk. Good optics, doesn't move the count.
notes.nomad: Two kilos, low value, no anchor, low risk. Doesn't hold anything up, doesn't save anyone either.
notes.fixer: Costs two, pays low, owed to nobody, risk's low. Buys goodwill, not survival — spend knowing that.

pack_items.title: Auto-route advisory
pack_items.depNote: a crew telemetry feed that doesn’t exist yet
pack_items.note: Routes crew by predicted risk. The predicting part still isn’t settled.

notes.infiltrator: Weight five, value medium, anchored to a feed not on file yet, risk high. Not ready to carry.
notes.influencer: Weight five on camera, medium value, needs a feed that doesn't exist yet, high risk. Not air-ready.
notes.nomad: Five kilos, medium value, needs a feed that isn't built yet, high risk. Not ready to bolt down.
notes.fixer: Costs five, pays medium, owed to a feed nobody's built, risk's high. Don't buy the unfinished.

pack_items.title: Medbay uplink
pack_items.note: Pipes vitals topside. Nobody’s agreed what Meridian gets to see.

notes.infiltrator: Weight five, value medium, anchored to the manifest sync, risk medium. Who reads it's unsettled.
notes.influencer: Weight five on camera, medium value, needs the manifest sync, medium risk. Who's watching's unsettled.
notes.nomad: Five kilos, medium value, needs the manifest sync first, medium risk. Who sees it below is unsettled.
notes.fixer: Costs five, pays medium, owed after the manifest sync, risk's medium. Who sees it's still unsettled.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text:
HARDLAND.EXE — Meridian Holdings has a hull breach in a platform shaft, and the lower deck is going under. Algorithmic Data Solutions Ltd holds the evacuation-systems contract; you're the ones climbing out with what you can carry.

One of you climbs with the pack. One of you stays on comms, reading the ledge below and the water rising behind it. Nothing here is graded by speed.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: Choose who climbs. This unit carries the pack and makes the call on every ledge.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: Choose who stays on comms. This unit reads the shaft and calls the weight limit.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text:
Readme — THE SHAFT.TXT

Eight items are staged at the base of the shaft. Weight limit for the first ledge: 13. Go over, and the pack does not close.

Some items anchor others — pack a dependent before its anchor and the ladder will not take it; drop an anchor and whatever depends on it comes back out with it.

Two fields are required before you climb: why this pack holds, and what you left behind on purpose. Fill both, then climb.

messages.speaker: handler
messages.text: Line's open. Report at each ledge; nothing else.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Pack's light, hatch is clear. Let's see what the logs don't already know.

messages.speaker: data
messages.text: You are the Infiltrator, climbing a flooding Meridian Holdings platform shaft with everything you can carry before the water decides for you; your Handler is on comms, keeping count of what it costs.

compel.trouble: My Former Employer Wants Me Back or Dead
compel.offer: Mid-climb, a line opens on the old contract. Your former employer's people can force the upper hatch, but only if their cameras ride the line up with you. Take it, or the hatch stays sealed and logged against you.
compel.acceptText: You take the key. Sponsor feed goes in the pack, locked, weight 2. +1 Fate point, logged.
compel.refuseText: You cut the line. Hatch stays sealed; you spend your starting Fate point instead.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: Choose who stays on comms. This unit reads the shaft and calls the weight limit.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text:
Readme — THE SHAFT.TXT

Eight items are staged at the base of the shaft. Weight limit for the first ledge: 13. Go over, and the pack does not close.

Some items anchor others — pack a dependent before its anchor and the ladder will not take it; drop an anchor and whatever depends on it comes back out with it.

Two fields are required before you climb: why this pack holds, and what you left behind on purpose. Fill both, then climb.

messages.speaker: handler
messages.text: You're live. Climb like everyone's watching, because they are.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Camera's rolling. Let's give them a climb worth watching.

messages.speaker: data
messages.text: You are the Influencer, climbing a flooding Meridian Holdings platform shaft with everything you can carry before the water decides for you; your Handler is on comms, keeping count of what it costs.

compel.trouble: I Can't Turn Off — The Stream Is Always Running
compel.offer: Mid-climb, Meridian pings the sponsor line. The stream is always running, and they want this climb live. Give them the feed, or the audience watches you cut to black at the worst possible ledge.
compel.acceptText: You give them the feed. It goes in the pack, locked, weight 2. +1 Fate point, on record.
compel.refuseText: You cut to a sponsor plug instead. Spend your starting Fate point; the real feed stays out.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: Choose who stays on comms. This unit reads the shaft and calls the weight limit.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text:
Readme — THE SHAFT.TXT

Eight items are staged at the base of the shaft. Weight limit for the first ledge: 13. Go over, and the pack does not close.

Some items anchor others — pack a dependent before its anchor and the ladder will not take it; drop an anchor and whatever depends on it comes back out with it.

Two fields are required before you climb: why this pack holds, and what you left behind on purpose. Fill both, then climb.

messages.speaker: handler
messages.text: Rope's set. Climb steady, mind the water.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Line's tied off. Let's see what's still bolted down there.

messages.speaker: data
messages.text: You are the Nomad, climbing a flooding Meridian Holdings platform shaft with everything you can carry before the water decides for you; your Handler is on comms, keeping count of what it costs.

compel.trouble: My Boat Is Falling Apart and Repairs Cost More Than I Make
compel.offer: Mid-climb, Meridian radios up: full repairs, no argument, if their camera rides the ladder with you. Take it and the feed's bolted into the pack. Turn it down and the boat stays as broke as it was.
compel.acceptText: Deal's done. Feed goes in the pack, locked, weight 2, repairs covered. +1 Fate point.
compel.refuseText: Deal's off. Spend your starting Fate point; boat stays broke, feed stays out of the pack.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: Choose who stays on comms. This unit reads the shaft and calls the weight limit.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text:
Readme — THE SHAFT.TXT

Eight items are staged at the base of the shaft. Weight limit for the first ledge: 13. Go over, and the pack does not close.

Some items anchor others — pack a dependent before its anchor and the ladder will not take it; drop an anchor and whatever depends on it comes back out with it.

Two fields are required before you climb: why this pack holds, and what you left behind on purpose. Fill both, then climb.

messages.speaker: handler
messages.text: You're covered, for now. Climb fast — nobody covers slow.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Everyone's covered. Let's see what this climb costs us.

messages.speaker: data
messages.text: You are the Fixer, climbing a flooding Meridian Holdings platform shaft with everything you can carry before the water decides for you; your Handler is on comms, keeping count of what it costs.

compel.trouble: I Owe Favors to Rival Corps — They'll Both Call Them In
compel.offer: Mid-climb, a rival corp calls in what you owe them: keep Meridian's cameras rolling and the debt's marked paid. Say yes and the feed's locked into the pack. Say no and you're still carrying that favor.
compel.acceptText: Debt's marked paid. Feed goes in the pack, locked, weight 2. +1 Fate point banked.
compel.refuseText: Debt stays open. Spend your starting Fate point; the feed never goes in the pack.

fields.label: Why does this pack hold, under the limit of 13?
What did you leave behind on purpose, and why?

pack.confirm: Climb with this pack? Weight {weight} of {limit}. Once you climb, the ledge below is gone.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: Sealing lower deck...

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: [SYSTEM ALERT] The water has taken the lower deck. Weight limit for this ledge: 10. Half the crew waiting below has no neural chrome, and the manual ladder release is the only way up that doesn't need it. The climb refuses without it in the pack.

fields.label: What changed under the limit of 10, and why?
What trade-off did you accept to make the new limit?

pack.confirm: Climb with this pack? Weight {weight} of {limit}. Once you climb, the ledge below is gone.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: Reading the new limit...

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: Uplink closing. What came up the shaft is below. The record is what you packed, dropped, and why.
